meta.title: Nano Unlock demo
meta.description: Sell part of a post for a few cents in Nano (XNO).
meta.author: nano133

steps.command:
wp post create --post_type=post --post_status=publish --post_name=nano-unlock-demo --post_title='How Nano confirms in under a second' --post_content='

This demo uses real Nano. The Unlock button below shows a real checkout: paying it sends about 1 cent of real XNO from your wallet to the nano133 demo wallet. This Playground site checks the payment with a real Nano node, and when it confirms (a few seconds), the paid part appears in this tab. The payment is final, and the unlock lasts only as long as this Playground tab. You do not have to pay to see the checkout: Cancel closes it.

Nano sends value between two accounts in under a second, with no fee. This first part is free.

The paid part: every Nano account has its own chain of blocks, so a one-cent sale pays the writer the full cent.

'
